cohort: 1610 mother-child pairs in Abu Dhabi, UAE, including 606 working mothers, with children under the age of two years
finding: Delayed initiation and cessation of breastfeeding are prevalent among working mothers in Abu Dhabi, with older maternal age, non-Arab nationality, cesarean section, non-rooming-in, and low birth weight being associated with delayed initiation, and non-Arab nationality and high income being associated with cessation.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly associated with delayed breastfeeding initiation among working mothers (AOR 2.70, 95% CI 1.84, 3.96).
